label: Get Started
heading: New to Marker? Start here.
description: Sign in, set up your profile and decide between a single scorecard and an event.

label: Score a Round
heading: Play a round with your group.
description: Create a scorecard, add your group and games, then score and follow the action as you play.

label: Run an Event
heading: Organize multiple groups.
description: Create the event, build the field and scorecards, add event games, then publish and follow live scoring.

label: Games and Handicaps
heading: Set up the competition your way.
description: Control handicap strokes, add side games across groups and configure games from a description.

label: Finish, Settle and Post
heading: Lock the results and settle up.
description: End the round or complete the event, see who pays whom, and post your score to GHIN.
